  • Method Details

    • get

      public static FundamentalFeedSupport.HttpAnswer get(String url, Map<String,String> headers) throws IOException, InterruptedException
      Sends a GET request with the request timeout. A 429 answer waits for its Retry-After, at most 60 seconds, and is repeated once; a second 429 is returned as it is.
      Parameters:
      url - the URL, which may carry a key
      headers - additional request headers
      Returns:
      the status and body of the answer
      Throws:
      IOException - when no answer arrives
      InterruptedException - when the waiting thread is interrupted
